macros.name: reftextlabelrange
macros.doc: This macro produces text that describes the range of figures, tables, or whatever the labels refer to, the default for English is “\ref{#1} to~\ref{#2}”.

macros.name: reftextpagerange
macros.doc: This macro produces text that describes the page range of the two labels, e.g., the default for English is “on pages~\pageref{#1}--\pageref{#2}}”.

macros.name: reftextvario
macros.doc: To allow a bit random variation in the generated strings one can use the command \reftextvario inside the string macros. It takes two arguments and selects one or the other for printing depending on the number of already seen \vref or \vpageref commands.

macros.name: vref
macros.doc: \vref is similar to \ref but adds an additional page reference, like ‘on the facing page’ or ‘on page 27’ whenever the corresponding \label is not on the same page.

macros.name: vrefrange
macros.doc: This command is similar to \vref but it takes two mandatory arguments denoting a range to refer to (e.g., a sequence of figures or a sequence of equations, etc.).

macros.name: vrefshowerrors
macros.doc: \vrefshowerrors ensures that varioref stops when detecting a possible loop.
